## Projects

### Distributed Linux Kernel Attestation System

Building a distributed system to verify Linux kernel integrity in real-time using loadable kernel modules, Netlink communication, and quorum-based consensus to detect unauthorized kernel modifications.

Role: Control Node & Attestation Server developer. Designed kernel-space monitoring architecture, implemented Netlink protocol communication, built consensus engine, and created HTTP-based control plane with cryptographic verification.

Technologies: Python, C, Linux Kernel Modules, Netlink Protocol, Flask, SHA256 Cryptography, OpenSSL

Features:
- Real-time kernel integrity monitoring via LKM
- Netlink-based kernel-userspace communication
- Quorum-based consensus engine for distributed attestation
- Cryptographic signing and verification of reports
- HTTP API for attestation report collection
- Trusted baseline management with operator prompts
- Structured audit logging and security alerts
- Secure Boot support with MOK key enrollment

Source: https://www.abhirupkumar.in/projects/distributed-linux-kernel-attestation
Repository: https://github.com/DevAdvancer/DLKA-System

### Femway - Women's Safety Car Booking Platform

Building a secure, role-based car booking platform specifically designed for women's safety and comfort, with admin verification, driver management, and passenger protection features.

Role: Sole developer. Designed secure database schema with RLS policies, implemented role-based authentication with admin code verification, built three distinct dashboards, and created responsive UI focused on safety.

Technologies: Next.js 15, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Vercel

Features:
- Role-based access control (Passenger, Driver, Admin)
- Secure authentication with 24-hour session management
- Admin verification system with secure codes
- Driver verification and document management
- Real-time ride booking and tracking
- Row Level Security (RLS) on all database tables

Source: https://www.abhirupkumar.in/projects/femway
Repository: https://github.com/DevAdvancer/Femway
Live project: https://femway.vercel.app

### Nexterm

Building an AI-powered terminal emulator that brings intelligent assistance to command-line workflows with natural language processing, error explanations, and context-aware suggestions.

Role: Sole developer.  Designed terminal architecture, implemented AI integration with multiple providers, built TUI with ratatui, and created security features for data sanitization.

Technologies: Rust, Ratatui, Tokio, Portable-pty, Ollama, Google Gemini API

Features:
- Full terminal emulation with PTY support
- AI-powered natural language command translation
- Dual AI provider support (Ollama & Google Gemini)
- Smart command history with fuzzy search
- Syntax highlighting & danger detection
- Privacy-focused data sanitization

Source: https://www.abhirupkumar.in/projects/nexterm

## Journal

### The Art of Minimalism in Design

Published: 2024-12-15
Source: https://www.abhirupkumar.in/blog/the-art-of-minimalism

Minimalism isn't about removing elements—it's about **amplifying what matters**.

## Why Minimalism Works

When we strip away the unnecessary, we create space for:

- **Clarity** — The message becomes crystal clear
- **Focus** — Users know exactly where to look
- **Elegance** — Beauty emerges from simplicity

> "Perfection is achieved, not when there is nothing more to add, but when there is nothing left to take away." — Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

## The Three Principles

### 1. Intentional White Space

White space isn't empty—it's breathing room. It gives your content the spotlight it deserves.

### 2. Purposeful Typography

Every font choice, every size, every weight should have a reason. Typography is the voice of your design.

### 3. Restrained Color

A limited palette creates harmony. Choose colors that serve the content, not distract from it.

## Conclusion

Minimalism is a practice of restraint and intention. When done well, it doesn't feel like anything is missing—it feels complete.

### Building with Intention

Published: 2024-12-10
Source: https://www.abhirupkumar.in/blog/building-with-intention

Every line of code is a decision. Every decision shapes the user experience.

## The Intentional Developer

Writing code isn't just about making things work—it's about making things **right**.

### Code as Communication

```typescript
// This communicates intent
const userPreferences = getUserPreferences();
const theme = userPreferences.prefersDarkMode ? 'dark' : 'light';

// This doesn't
const t = u.d ? 'd' : 'l';
```

## The Ripple Effect

Small decisions compound:

1. Clear naming leads to maintainable code
2. Maintainable code leads to faster iteration
3. Faster iteration leads to better products
4. Better products lead to happier users

## Conclusion

Build with intention. Your future self—and your users—will thank you.

### Finding Creativity in Constraints

Published: 2024-12-05
Source: https://www.abhirupkumar.in/blog/finding-creativity

The blank page is terrifying. Constraints set you free.

## The Paradox of Choice

When everything is possible, nothing gets done. Constraints give us:

- **Direction** — A starting point
- **Focus** — Clear boundaries
- **Innovation** — Creative problem-solving

## Famous Constraints

### Twitter's 140 Characters

The limit forced clarity. Every word had to earn its place.

### Instagram's Square Photos

The format became iconic. Constraints created a recognizable aesthetic.

## Embracing Limitations

Next time you face a constraint, don't fight it. Ask yourself:

> "How can this limitation become my advantage?"

The answer might surprise you.
